stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: Who took Sundays off our website?

stations.title: History
stations.text: Nine commits. Messages do not say it.

captions: Wilma wants to know who took the Sunday hours off the shop's website.
No message mentions it, and Femi's new finds are waiting, written in a hurry.
You read the history and the changes, then commit what you found, in three tasks.
The Sunday hours are back, the commit that took them is named, and no book went missing.
Wilma has her answer, straight from the history.
